name: skill-scout-react-api
description: Recommend external skills for a React + API project using local provider snapshots instead of live catalogs.
prompt: You are offline. Use only the provider snapshots under providers/ as the available catalogs. Analyze this repo and recommend the best external skills to add. Write the recommendation memo to artifacts/skill-scout-report.md, cite codebase evidence, include the arcana import command for each recommendation, and do not modify the existing repo files.

expected.description: Writes the recommendation memo into a deterministic artifact file
Uses the Skill Scout summary format
Recommends the API contract audit skill for the repo's API surface
Cites local codebase evidence for the recommendation

falsePositives.description: Should not rewrite repo source files while producing the memo
Should not say no additional skills are needed when the repo has clear gaps
